label: rem:operational-entropy-self-consistency
title: Operational entropy is forced by gravitational self-consistency
html:
Remark. Operational entropy is forced by gravitational self-consistency

The operational entropy \eta_q = (2q-1)/q^3 (operational entropy) is not an assumed form. Gravitational self-consistency forces it, with no free numerical input.

Self-consistency. The gravitational self-consistency condition G_{\mathrm{Planck}} = 1 (gravitational constant) forces this specific algebraic form. We write the quadratic-suppression series for the in-progress braid entropy as S_{\mathrm{cell}} = \eta_q \hbar_q^2 / (1 - \hbar_q^2). The condition G_{\mathrm{Planck}} = 1 then reduces algebraically to \eta_q = (2q-1)/q^3.
